Please remove all monospace formatting, and apply the following formatting instead:

* index: [[variable]]
* '0', '1', 0, 1: {{constant}}, and remove the quotation marks
* line numbers: <<bold>>

Please also specify whether index is 0-based or 1-based.

Please reduce the upper bound of 100 to 10 to match the existing cases. Please also update the stub generator accordingly.

Thanks.

If you intend to keep Reverse mode enabled, please remove Lines 5 to 13 in the stub generator.

Thanks.
